# 💳 Google Workflow Helpers (gws CLI)

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — the cross-service workflow module of the gws CLI: five productivity helpers (`gws workflow <resource> <method> [flags]`) — +standup-report (today's meetings + open tasks), +meeting-prep (agenda, attendees, linked docs), +email-to-task (turn a Gmail message into a Google Tasks entry), +weekly-digest (this week's meetings + unread email count) and +file-announce (announce a Drive file in a Chat space) — with schema discovery before calling any API method. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: you still need the gws binary installed and authenticated, and the shared auth/security rules live in a separate gws-shared skill the agent must read first; these are convenience wrappers, not replacements for the underlying Workspace apps. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
